What was not found:

Backup Power.note:
Backup Power:
- The Wisconsin Public Service peaking plants page (https://wisconsinpublicservice.com/company/peaking) lists West Marinette with 'Gas Turbine - WM33' in its table of peaking units. The page says peaking plants provide electricity when customers' needs are highest, so the unit supplies the grid and is not a backup unit for one site.
- The value no stays as it is. The page does not use the words backup power.

units.notes: Unit 33 is still listed as operating by EIA with no retirement planned. Backup Power no is supported by the owner's peaking plant page.
